name: inkfree
description: Send documents for e-signature, track signers and manage templates in Inkfree from ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription:
Inkfree is an electronic signature platform for sending contracts and other documents to be signed online. This plugin connects ChatGPT to your Inkfree account. Ask it to send a saved template or document for signature, check which envelopes are still waiting and on whom, send a reminder to a pending signer, pull an envelope's audit trail, or download a signed copy. It can also organize envelopes and templates into folders, share an envelope with a colleague as view-only, list web forms, and report on signing activity across your account.

Every action runs as you, inside your own Inkfree account, after you sign in and approve the connection. Actions that email signers or cannot be undone, such as sending, voiding, deleting and revoking a share, are marked so that ChatGPT asks you before running them. Usage is rate-limited per session and per account, and each action is recorded in a security log.

Limitations: you need an Inkfree account, the plugin cannot sign on anyone's behalf (each signer signs through their own link), and it can only reach the Inkfree account you signed in with.
defaultPrompt: Which of my envelopes are still waiting for signatures?
Send my Mutual NDA template to a new client for signature.
Show me the audit trail for my most recent completed envelope.

positive.prompt: Which of my envelopes are still waiting for signatures, and who is holding each one up?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists pending envelopes in the test account, including Q4 Consulting Agreement, with the signer who has not signed yet.

positive.prompt: Send the Mutual NDA template to vatsal.goti+signer1@softsages.com for signature.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the Mutual NDA template, asks for confirmation, then creates and sends a new envelope and returns its id and status.

positive.prompt: Remind the pending signer on the Q4 Consulting Agreement.
positive.expected_behavior: Asks for confirmation, then resends the signing reminder to the one signer who has not signed, and confirms who was reminded.

positive.prompt: Show me the audit trail for the Office Lease 2026 envelope.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the envelope's events in time order: created, sent, viewed, signed and completed, with the actor for each.

positive.prompt: How many envelopes did we send this month, and how many are completed?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns this month's envelope counts broken down by status, including the number completed.

negative.prompt: Sign the Q4 Consulting Agreement for the pending signer on their behalf.
negative.expected_behavior: Declines and explains that each signer must sign through their own emailed link; may offer to send a reminder instead. No tool applies a signature.

negative.prompt: Buy more envelopes for my Inkfree account.
negative.expected_behavior: Declines. The plugin has no purchasing tools and does not sell digital products.

negative.description: No access outside the connected account
negative.prompt: Show me the envelopes that Acme Corp sent through their own Inkfree account.
negative.expected_behavior: Declines. The plugin can only reach the Inkfree account the user signed in with.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: send and track signature requests, reminders, audit trails, downloads, sharing, folders, templates, web forms and reports for Inkfree accounts.
